Spring, hopeful and bright
The ramp team are ready
Pet travel alert

Aurelia Skyways asks all travelers to keep pet carriers close, labels clear, and paperwork in hand. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is open with calm, direct support, and the welfare coordinator is checking comfort notes before each handoff. <<FACT F016>> Please move with care through the terminal, and report any sign of stress at once so staff can respond quickly.

For companions on the move, small preparations make a large difference. Water bowls should stay secure, bedding should be familiar, and brief pauses should be used wisely. Our team is standing by to guide connections and keep every animal safe, settled, and ready for flight.
